# Git Workspace Scan

Discovers Git repositories and linked worktrees beneath scan roots, keyed by deterministic normalized-path IDs. Linked worktrees are opened using LibGit2Sharp, not a Git subprocess, and record their owning-repository path.

## Lifecycle and safety

Every discovery route (explicit roots, recursive traversal, linked paths and final admission) unconditionally rejects complete `$Recycle.Bin` ancestor components, case-insensitively. Custom or empty excludes cannot disable this protection. Names such as `$Recycle.Bin-backup` remain eligible.

After discovery, a bounded pass reconciles all indexed local `git`/`git-worktree` entities, including legacy entities without an explicit profile owner. Explicitly foreign-profile entities are never probed or changed. Existing recycled workspaces are hidden through the deterministic system `not-interesting` relationship without falsifying filesystem existence. Confirmed missing paths on accessible ancestors are marked missing and hidden. Offline/unready drives, access/IO errors, invalid paths and unknown availability preserve prior existence, metadata and visibility and report diagnostics. Absence from discoveries, changed roots, configured exclusions, failed LibGit2Sharp metadata reads or omitted linked callbacks are not deletion evidence.

Restoration outside recycle ancestry removes only the system relationship, including a stranded hide when existence is already true. Independent user hides survive. Durable reconciliation intent permits recovery after partial writes, while completed missing/recycled states respect manual unhide. Availability and entity concurrency are rechecked before relationship changes. No workspace entity, file, directory or Git registration is deleted. Names, display names and last-known metadata are preserved when Git metadata is unavailable.

## Configuration

### `excludes`

Case-insensitive normalized paths whose entire discovery subtrees are skipped, with separator boundaries. Default: `["%TEMP%"]`; an explicit array replaces this configurable default only. Excludes apply to linked worktrees too and never imply deletion of an indexed entity.

### Environment-variable substitution

`Environment.ExpandEnvironmentVariables` expands `%NAME%` references in profile home directories, filesystem-path participants and excludes before normalization.

### Scan roots

The current `user-computer-profile` contributes all ready fixed local drive roots. Current-profile participants contribute their home directory or `filesystem-path` path; foreign-profile paths are ignored. Directory depth is unlimited (`int.MaxValue`).

## Usage

Wire a `tool-relationship` with `participants.tool` pointing to this tool, current-profile `participants.target` scan-root entities, and a `participants.schedule`. Full-drive scanning can be slow; hourly or daily scheduling is typical. Set `paused: true` on the relationship to disable scans without deletion. The summary includes discovery counts and indexed-entity reconciliation diagnostics.
